summary.headline: Tencent scientist warns AI biology skills near a harm threshold
summary.body: A quieter Saturday. Tencent's chief AI scientist warned that AI biology skills are near a 'can do harm' threshold, and Google DeepMind said AI found new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA. Both raised Catastrophic Risk, which rose 0.33. OpenAI closed an $11 billion first tranche at a $1.25 trillion valuation, below its earlier target, nudging Power Concentration up. Self-Destruction rose and the two utopias slipped. Horizon Balance fell to -18.49 from -18.23.
summary.movers_note: Self-Destruction +0.39, from the Tencent warning (+0.26) and the RSA finding (+0.12). Libertarian Utopia -0.23, mainly from the Tencent warning (-0.12). Egalitarian Utopia -0.17, mainly from the Tencent warning (-0.10).

events.title: OpenAI closes $11B first tranche at $1.25T valuation, below its earlier target
events.summary: OpenAI raised about $11 billion from investors including Coatue and T. Rowe Price at a $1.25 trillion valuation, the first close of a round that may reach $20 billion, after cutting its target from at least $30 billion at about $1.4 trillion.
events.reason: More capital to a leading lab concentrates power (F5 up), but the cut target signals investor caution; a development of the scored ~$30B round, T1.

events.title: Tencent's chief AI scientist warns AI biology skills near a 'can do harm' threshold
events.summary: Speaking in Hong Kong, Tencent chief AI scientist Yao Shunyu said AI cyber abilities already pose risks, biology capabilities will soon cross a harm threshold that may be harder to manage than cyber, and Chinese open-model releasers must take safety seriously.
events.reason: A senior Chinese lab leader flagging near-term bio-misuse capability is a risk signal (F8 up); words, not an incident, so T1.

events.title: Google DeepMind says AI found new weaknesses in legacy 1024-bit RSA
events.summary: DeepMind reported AI-assisted attacks on legacy 1024-bit RSA, including a theoretical ~1,600x signature-forgery efficiency gain and a padding-attack result, while stating 2048-bit and larger keys remain secure; no peer-reviewed paper yet.
events.reason: AI-driven cryptanalysis of deployed (if legacy) crypto shows offensive security capability (F8 up); legacy keys only and not peer reviewed, so T1.
